seed_rationale: Conditional BUB1B loss of function hypothesis from prior local variant work. This is not a confirmed causal diagnosis or a measured expression signature.
primary_target_policy: Only source-labelled direct interactions with human SINGLE PROTEIN targets. Protein-family and complex components remain contextual associations, not independently proven binding targets.

direction_sources.scope: Spindle checkpoint function and component roles; undirected pathway membership alone does not specify therapeutic direction.
Mps1 inhibition disrupts spindle-checkpoint signalling; supports flagging inhibition as a potential conflict with normal-cell restoration.
Bub1 kinase and Aurora B roles in checkpoint signalling and chromosome error correction. More activity is not automatically beneficial.

statistical_scope: All assessable phase-4 parent drug families enter both nominal and degree-stratified overlap tests and separate BH corrections. Degree is the number of drug families with an annotated direct target, not protein-interaction-network degree. No p-value estimates efficacy.
